Dear Mr.Theriault:
Trihydro Corporation(Trihydro)is providing an amendment request for the City of Cheyenne
Professional Services Agreement #6798for the Happy Jack Landfill Environmental Monitoring project.
As outlined in Trihydro's original proposal under Request for Proposal, RFP-10-18, anticipated work
included assistance with off-site water well monitoring.Costs were not originally included in the
proposal perthe City's direction because of the uncertainty regarding the timing for commencement of
theoff-site monitoring program anddetails of the scope ofwork.Based on recent conversations with the
City, Trihydro better understands the scope andhas prepared this contract amendment request to assist
with the upcoming task.The off-site water well monitoring program is required by the Wyoming
Department of Environmental Quality.The scope includes four items:
Task 1: Landowner well identification and notification.Trihydro will verify private and public
drinking and stock water wells within one-half mileof the landfill expansion area boundary for
inclusion in the program.Tri hydro will prepare landowner notifications and information for the
City's use to gauge landowner's interest in participating inthe off-site water well monitoring
program. Trihydro will track responses from potential program participants.
Task 2: Landowner meeting.Trihydro will prepare a presentation and hold a landowner meeting
(virtual orin-person)todiscuss the off-site well monitoring program and register program
participants.
Task 3: Preparation of Sampling and Analysis Plan (SAP). Trihydro will tour program wells and
developa sampling methodology for each individual well location.ASAPwill then be prepared and
submitted toW DE Q for approval.
Task 4: Quarterly sampling and reporting.Each well enrolled in the program will be sampled on a
quarterly basis for one year.Program participants will be provided withwater quality information for
the irrespective wells.If necessary, a landowner meeting will be conductedat the conclusion of the
sampling programto answer landowner questions regarding the data and to proactively address any
concerns.
